scuttler.review: accepted on attempt 2 of 3: low wide tick, wedge head, splayed legs; eight legs where the brief says four

stalker.review: accepted on attempt 2: mantis-raptor with long bone scythe blades, digitigrade legs, hunched upright body; the whole beak-like head glows rather than separate eyes

seeker.review: accepted on attempt 3 of 3: vertical ring around the eye sphere, orange lens in front, bone fins swept back, nothing below

colossus.review: accepted on attempt 2: armoured quadruped with a siege tower; red glow on the front proboscis

hero.review: accepted on attempt 2: heavy bone pauldrons, rifle across the body, cyan visor

monolith.review: accepted on attempt 1: dark faceted slab, one orange seam on the front, bone ribs

pylon.review: accepted on attempt 1: rusted lattice tower with cross-arms and a bent vane; thin rods vanish at distance as intended

rock_spire.review: accepted on attempt 1: tall faceted spire with bone mineral facets; the small surface nubs vanish at distance

hive_spire.review: accepted on attempt 1: twisted spire with bone ribs and orange pores near the top; the flared foot reads as roots
